data.description:
## Bug Report

**Priority**: 3 (normal)
**Zero Inference Rule**: Directly observed in diff for PR #337 by FP-recovery opus review.

## Observed behavior
ref-query.sh and ref-query.py have two divergences:
1. SKIP_NAMES: ref-query.sh uses {'_index.yaml', '_schema.yaml'} but ref-query.py uses frozenset({'_index.yaml', '_schema.yaml', '_schema-anti-patterns.yaml'}) — the .sh version loads _schema-anti-patterns.yaml as if it were a corpus entry.
2. BM25 IDF term: ref-query.sh stdlib bm25_score (line 182) lacks the IDF term used in ref-query.py's bm25_score — .sh implements only TF normalization without inverse document frequency. Since dso ref-query shim resolves to ref-query.sh, users get inferior ranking.

## Expected behavior
ref-query.sh and ref-query.py produce identical rankings for the same query.

## Fix
1. Add '_schema-anti-patterns.yaml' to SKIP_NAMES in ref-query.sh
2. Add IDF term to stdlib bm25_score in ref-query.sh to match ref-query.py implementation
data.title: ref-query.sh stdlib BM25 missing IDF term; SKIP_NAMES diverges from ref-query.py
